title: Well made and look nice!
text: Well made and look nice!. The rope that’s wrapped around each votive is very nice and well made. The actors are nice as well. I highly recommend these for any nautical theme

product_metadata.title: Kate Aspen Anchors Away Rope Tealight Votive Candle Holder, Beach Theme Wedding Decorations, Wedding Favors, Nautical Decor, Gift Package Set of 4
features: TEA LIGHT HOLDER - Each frosted glass votive holds one tea light, tea light included
GIFT PACKAGED - Come packaged with a decorative gift band with dark blue and white stripes and nautical design
QUALITY - Frosted glass votive wrapped with real cotton rope detailing and resin anchor charm
MEASUREMENTS - Measures 2.75 w x 2 in diameter
description: One if by land, two if by sea. You and this nautical favor are just meant to be! Designed by Kate Aspen, our "Anchors Away" Rope Tealight Holders add a charming touch as placeholders or party favors for your sea-inspired special occasion.
